mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `post` WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `post` (title, content, author_id, author_name, view_count, agree_count, disagree_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, 0, 0, 0, 1, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `post` SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET agree_count = agree_count + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET disagree_count = disagree_count + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
